sampling_strata.name: near_boundary
sampling_strata.sampling_rule: start with six independent Uniform[-pi, pi] coordinates; choose two coordinates uniformly without replacement; independently for each selected coordinate k, draw s_k Uniform{-1, +1} and delta_k Uniform[0.01, 0.08], then set x_k = s_k * (pi - delta_k)

sampling_strata.name: diagonal_off_axis
sampling_strata.sampling_rule: draw magnitude Uniform[0.2, pi] and six independent uniform signs; return magnitude times the sign vector

sampling_strata.name: sign_related_pairs
sampling_strata.sampling_rule: draw four bases with six independent Uniform[-pi, pi] coordinates; for each base return the base and its coordinatewise product with a uniform sign vector conditioned to contain at least one -1
